name: Projection Persistence Dynamics Registry
purpose: Define how projection-induced persistence structures stabilize, deform, bifurcate, or dissolve under recursive admissibility constraints.

core_definition.canonical_statement: Projection persistence dynamics describe how projection-induced structures maintain or lose stabilized continuation coherence under bounded admissibility conditions.
core_definition.non_primitive_rule: Persistence behavior remains projection-derived and may not be treated as independent ontology.

dynamic_states.name: stabilized_persistence
dynamic_states.definition: Projection-induced structure maintains bounded continuation coherence.

dynamic_states.name: deforming_persistence
dynamic_states.definition: Projection-induced structure retains continuity while changing orientation or admissibility profile.

dynamic_states.name: bifurcating_persistence
dynamic_states.definition: Projection-induced structure splits into multiple continuation-compatible persistence pathways.

dynamic_states.name: metastable_persistence
dynamic_states.definition: Projection-induced structure temporarily maintains coherence near admissibility failure boundaries.

dynamic_states.name: dissolving_persistence
dynamic_states.definition: Projection-induced structure loses continuation coherence and collapses below persistence thresholds.

transition_conditions.condition: orientation_consistency changes while local admissibility remains bounded
continuation coherence approaches admissibility boundary instability
continuation coherence falls below bounded persistence threshold

governance_rules.rule: Persistence stabilization does not imply primitive ontology.
Dissolution of persistence structures does not imply invalidity of source relations.
Projection persistence dynamics may not be interpreted as physical spacetime evolution.

allowed_uses: Analyzing stabilization and dissolution of projection-induced geometry-like structures.
Comparing persistence stability across multiple projection depths.
forbidden_uses: Treating persistence structures as primitive entities.
Claiming persistence dynamics derive physical spacetime evolution.
Treating metastability as proof of ontology.
Treating projection persistence as direct evidence for QM/GR.
